archetypes.name: drafter-routing
archetypes.rationale: Default vendor selection and model fallback behavior are the highest-risk contract changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 2b drafter routing changes. Focus on unset versus explicit LARCH_DESIGN_DRAFTER behavior, LARCH_DESIGN_PLAN_MODEL defaulting, and whether the harness actually prevents accidental Codex default regressions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
